description: 16 fade channels, each taking a stereo pair of signals and fading them up or down on a curve you set

params.text: The time a fade in takes, 0.05 to 100 seconds and 20 seconds on arrival; a higher setting gives a longer fade, despite the column being marked Speed
The time a fade out takes, 0.05 to 100 seconds and 20 seconds on arrival; a higher setting gives a longer fade, despite the column being marked Speed
Bends the fade curve, -1 to 3, with 0 a straight line; below 0 the level climbs early in a fade in, above 0 it stays low until the end. Default -0.7
Flips that channel between fading in and fading out; it latches, and the channel stays open for as long as it is on

inputs.text: A rising edge past 0.01V flips that channel's button, so a channel that was fading in starts fading out and one that was out starts fading in
The left signal of that fade channel, multiplied by the channel's fade level on its way to the L output; a polyphonic cable is summed to one channel first
The right signal of that fade channel, multiplied by the channel's fade level on its way to the R output; a polyphonic cable is summed to one channel first

outputs.text: The L input of that channel scaled by its fade level; with nothing patched to that input the jack carries the fade shape itself, 0V to 10V
The R input of that channel scaled by its fade level; with nothing patched to that input the jack carries the fade shape itself, 0V to 10V

notes: every channel arrives faded out and passes nothing. Press a channel's button, or send a rising edge to its trigger jack, to fade it in.
the number readout shows the value of the Speed knob last turned. The Slope knobs do not write to it, so it shows a fade time and nothing else.
